screens.purpose: Show a reusable letter template with merge fields
Set up bulk generation for many employees
Preview merged letters and send for approval
Signatory approves and signs the batch
Admin releases signed letters with delivery options
Employee opens and acknowledges the letter

flows.name: Increment letters from template to acknowledgement

steps.user_action: Reviews the template, clicks Use template
steps.system_response: Opens Generate letters with the template chosen

steps.user_action: Picks approval type, signatory and employee filter, clicks Preview letters
Steps to the next letter, clicks Send for approval
steps.system_response: Batch sent to the signatory, opens the signatory inbox

steps.user_action: Keeps delivery options on, clicks Release 24 letters
steps.system_response: Letters delivered, opens the employee's documents
